prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is for claim purposes. Do you understand that and consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand and I consent.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.

A: I'd rather not give my full address on the recording, but I can confirm I live in Houston.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened on the day of the accident?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Houston and I was turning left. I had a green light, or at least I thought I did. I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when a car coming the other way hit the front of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I was focused on the oncoming traffic and I didn't notice it until it was on top of me.

Q: How fast were you going when you started your turn?

A: I was almost stopped. I'd say maybe ten miles an hour at most.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Have you been injured as a result of the collision?

A: Yes. My right shoulder took the brunt of it. It hurts when I lift my arm above my head, and I've had trouble sleeping on that side.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and I've scheduled a follow-up with my doctor to look at the shoulder.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just hope this gets sorted out quickly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
